overall_fault_detection.definition: Was an incident opened? Positives: every injected-fault scenario, all fault categories. Negatives: clean control batches. A scenario counts as detected when the monitoring run reports an incident, raised by any monitor.

overall_fault_detection_f1.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over scenarios, 2000 resamples, fixed seed

drift_detection.definition: Did the drift monitor flag a distribution change? Positives: only the covariate-drift scenarios (numerical shift F01, categorical shift F02, scaling error F04). Negatives: the same clean control batches. A scenario counts as detected only when the drift monitor itself triggers; an incident raised by another monitor does not count.

drift_detection_f1.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over scenarios, 2000 resamples, fixed seed

methods_compared.note: same population as drift_detection; 'monitor' is the shipped rule

remediation.simulation_note: In the benchmark, approval, execution and rollback are simulated in-process (no human, API or database). The API/database path is exercised by the end-to-end tests.

validation_success_rate.definition: validation attempts that passed / all validation attempts

regression_failure_rate.definition: validation attempts with a failed regression check / all validation attempts

supported_fault_remediation_success.definition: detected scenarios of a fault with an automatable fix where the expected action was proposed AND its validation passed / all detected scenarios of such faults. The denominator is scenarios, not validation attempts: a wrong or missing proposal counts as a failure.

execution_resolution_rate.definition: executed fixes after which the incident batch was healthy / executed fixes

rollback_success_rate.definition: rollbacks that restored the previous state / rollback attempts

accounting_identities.name: every proposal has exactly one terminal status
approval requests = approved + rejected + still pending
actionable proposals = rejected before validation + investigate-more + cancelled before validation + validation attempts
